entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I hope someone can help me. I need to return something, and I'm just so disappointed.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
It's Maria Garcia, order number 88-Kilo-4-7-2. It's about the ProFit Jersey I bought. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I saved up for this. I really needed this to be perfect.

I understand, Maria, and I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. To make sure I find the best solution, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?

It's just the wrong size. I used the size chart, but it's incredibly tight across the chest. I was hoping for an exchange, but honestly... with things being the way they are, I think I just need the money back.

I see. It's definitely frustrating when an item is too tight and doesn't fit as you expected. So, to confirm, you'd prefer a full refund for the jersey rather than an exchange for a larger size, correct?
Yes, please. I was really counting on that money if it didn't work out.

Okay, let me check the details for you. One moment... I see your order was delivered 34 days ago. Let's see... yes, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window, so I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful. Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. That's a huge relief.

You're very welcome, Maria. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Okay, that sounds perfect. Thank you again for your help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
